authority.scope: GTK2 private engine partial-expose and resize investigation. No installed theme changes.

environment.palette_fixture: The archived RC contains fixed fixture colors solely to isolate repaint mechanics; palette-role behavior was not tested.

findings.partial_repaint: For each of the four normal-state 15x15 stepper cells, a deliberate one-pixel change in its outer area was observed in the GTK2 expose event. The after-expose handler restored the affected pixel; each cell moved from 1/225 changed pixels to 0/225 against its baseline.
findings.resize: A full expose after resizing updated cached cell positions to H-left (2,0), H-right (243,0), V-up (122,22), V-down (122,57). All four normal cells exactly matched their existing 15x15 assets before and after the partial-damage checks; each post-resize one-pixel damage returned to 0/225 in its cell.
findings.input: The R521 input probe was run with R535 loaded. Its eight cases passed: interior movement, blocked endpoints, and globally insensitive horizontal/vertical ranges. The GTK2 debug trace includes R535 style and after-expose callbacks.
findings.r534_relation: R534 remains an accurate record of the separate harness experiment and its then-pending engine integration. R535 supersedes only that engine-integration limitation; it does not prove interaction-state rendering or historical/visual acceptance.

limits: Only normal-state appearance and partial repaint were pixel-verified. The input probe does not validate hover, pressed, release, endpoint appearance, or globally insensitive appearance.
Independent source review found that GTK2 computes PRELIGHT/ACTIVE per stepper; R535 caches state from draw callbacks and can redraw a stale normal asset over a hovered or pressed stepper.
The cache is not explicitly invalidated when stepper configuration removes a direction. Repeated PNG loads during expose also remain a performance concern.
The RC's fixed fixture colors are not a product palette and provide no evidence that the theme follows current KDE color roles.
No fresh Domain/OS SR10.4/HP VUE 2.01 comparison, live user-application comparison, package integration, installation, or human visual acceptance was performed.
next: In a separate private prototype, make repaint state-specific for each stepper, invalidate absent/stale cells, cache assets instead of reopening PNGs on each draw, then test hover/pressed/release/disabled transitions and repeat endpoint input blocking. Keep the installed theme unchanged; obtain SR10.4 visual comparison only from this project's VM under its coordination rules.
